## Skip to the front of 50+ deeptech VC inboxes

We are the curated channel where the best deeptech deals reach the best deeptech investors. There's no program to attend and you don't give up equity to participate.

Submit your deck, we'll take a look, and we'll forward the good ones to investors who invest in your space. Our guarantee is that we look through every deck.

For each deck, we write a one-pager explaining why VCs should care — relating to the investor's thesis, portfolio, and _your_ startup's angle. Because of how much time we put in, Deep Checks is far more effective for meeting VCs than cold emailing.

By getting a check from one of us domain-expert VCs, we help validate to other VCs that you're among the best in your space, which increases fundraising momentum. Further, getting in front of this many VCs at once pressures them to move fast to get in—and that helps you close quicker and get a higher valuation.

Gaurab is the co-founder and CEO of Solugen. As a physician-scientist, Gaurab took an oath to first do no harm—and for him, that goes beyond patients or medicine. Gaurab believes in using biology in unconventional ways to solve incredibly complex problems and is building a world-class team to join him on the journey.

Gaurab studied computational neuroscience as an undergraduate at Brown University and received his MD & PhD in cancer biology and enzymology at the University of Texas. About

John Gedmark is CEO & Cofounder of Astranis and an aerospace engineer. Astranis builds and operates small, low-cost telecommunications satellites for high orbits, starting with geostationary orbit (GEO). Astranis is deploying satellites on contract for enterprise and government customers around the world, bringing low-cost broadband internet to remote and underserved areas. The company has raised over $500 million to date with rounds led by Andreessen Horowitz, Venrock, and Blackrock, and has a team of 300 based out of their San Francisco Bay Area headquarters.

John cofounded and served as Executive Director of the Commercial Spaceflight Federation, the industry association for new space companies including SpaceX, Blue Origin, and Virgin Galactic. John reported to a CEO-level board of directors and led the commercial space industry's efforts to privatize flights of NASA astronauts to low Earth orbit, a historic shift worth more than $10 billion to the commercial space industry.

Previously John served as the Director of Rocket Flight Operations for the X Prize Foundation. John holds a Bachelor of Science degree from Purdue University and a Master of Science degree from Stanford University, both in aerospace engineering, with a focus on rocket propulsion.

Joe Wilson is the Founder and Managing Partner of Undeterred Capital, an early stage venture firm investing exclusively in deep tech and bioscience companies at the pre-seed and seed stages. Joe has worked as a deep tech operator for over a decade and was previously the co-founder and COO of Multiply Labs, a pharmaceutical robotics company that was spun out of MIT in 2016 and that has raised over $25M to date.

Undeterred has a portfolio of 17 companies collectively valued at over $1 billion. Investments to date include AI for drug discovery and formulation, gas fermentation for carbon-negative food production, advanced robotic systems for fish processing, and diagnostics for early detection of ovarian cancer, among others.

About

Rayyan is the Co-founder and General Partner of 8090 Industries, a VC firm backed by global energy and industrial titans, focused on breakthrough science, decarbonization and national security. The companies Rayyan has invested in have grown to $8B+ in private market value and employ 5,000+ people across the US -  including groundbreaking companies like EquipmentShare, Astranis, Infinium, Quaise, Regent, Living Carbon and Liberation Labs. Rayyan serves on the Boards of Oklo, Cemvita, Circ, Maple Materials and is a Co-founder of Gold Hydrogen, a producer of abundant clean hydrogen from microbes and old oil wells for less than $1/kg.

Rayyan was recognized by Business Insider as one of the top 100 early-stage investors of 2023 and amongst “the most powerful seed stage climate tech VCs” by Fortune Magazine. Every Sunday, Rayyan publishes Decarbon Weekly - providing energy transition insights to C-Suite execs, entrepreneurs and government leaders. Outside of 8090 Industries, Rayyan helps commercialize frontier science at Loomis Labs, advises the Earth BioGenome Project and helps equip the US defense apparatus with new capabilities and technologies.

#### Precursor Ventures

Precursor Ventures is an early-stage generalist fund started in 2015, specializing in pre-seed and seed investments. The firm backs founders at the very beginning of their journey — often before a product is fully built or a team is complete — with a thesis centered on exceptional people pursuing large markets.

About

Marina Girgis is a Principal at Precursor Ventures. Before joining the fund in 2021, Marina researched public semiconductor and hardware stocks such as Nvidia, Intel, Apple, and others, at Bloomberg's equity research division. While her background lies in semiconductors, Marina now invests across sectors, driven by a passion for unique ideas and hard-to-replicate tech. Her investments span aerospace, energy, marketplaces, cybersecurity, and more.

## FAQ

#### Why should I submit?

We're the most efficient way to reach deeptech investors who specialize in your niche. Over nearly three years, we've done the hard work of vetting all the legitimate investors in your space and building relationships with them. We have coverage across every sector we've encountered. Cancer drug discovery platform? Mining sensors? Battlefield robots? Nuclear reactors? Bring it on. Nothing is too niche.

#### Which startups should submit?

Any deeptech sector, e.g. hardware, biotech (but not pharma), space, robotics, chips, materials, and energy. Please do not submit traditional SaaS/software companies.

As long as your valuation is $20M or below, apply at any stage—pre-incorporation, pure idea, prototype, post-accelerator, revenue—no time is too early.

All geographies are welcome.

#### What happens after I submit?

We exist to ensure no good deck goes overlooked by deeptech VCs.

Every single deck is looked at. That's our guarantee to founders.

The best decks are identified and surfaced to the investors directly. Those investors are vetted general partners and associates at deeptech venture funds who invest at seed. Many of them are listed on this page.

Interested investors individually reach out to founders. We don't invest as a group, and there is no program to attend.

If you don't hear from investors, it means no investors were interested. Note that we don't provide feedback on your deck submission—we just route deals to the investors.

#### How can we get you to talk at our university?

Fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/yVerimn4AT9jDqEw9) to let us know you're interested.

#### Is there a program to attend?

There is no program and nothing to do beyond submitting your deck and/or memo. Deep Checks is simply a way to get into multiple investors' inboxes with priority, and to lessen the chance of your deck being overlooked by ensuring we take each one seriously.

#### Who sees my deck?

The investors on this site, their fund staff, and additional VC fund partners we're trialing for inclusion into the group. If founders tell us they have good experiences with the additional VCs, we keep them on. Our goal is to maximize the number of intros we get you—so long as it's to VCs we know and trust and who actively invest in seed-stage deeptech without wasting founders' time.

#### Who's the team behind Deep Checks?

Deep Checks was created by the team at [Julian Capital](https://julian.capital/), a deeptech seed fund that helps its founders with growth and recruiting, alongside assistance from the deeptech community, including seed funds [Undeterred](https://undeterredcapital.com/) (Joe Wilson) and [Humba Ventures](https://humbaventures.com/) (Leo Polovets).

If you'd like to ask us questions, please email [john@deepchecks.vc](mailto:john@deepchecks.vc?subject=Deep%20Checks%20question).
